source: docs/research/period-gui-suite.md section 4; user R4.4 scope; spec/toolbox_gate.h sections 10 and 12
format: Initech private fixed records, all integers little endian
checksum: FNV-1a 32 over the entire file, treating offsets 12..15 as zero; basis 2166136261, multiplier 16777619
text: single-byte TEXT (including extended bytes and tabs) and CR; LF/CRLF Scrap imports become CR; NUL and other control bytes are refused; no PICT support
validation: exact file length, magic, version, slot/count/current bounds, checksum, record lengths, single-byte text, zero padding and unused records; malformed file resets all pages and emits DA-CORRUPT via DOS AUX
save: page turn and close; writes and closes through the existing DOS-backed Toolbox file verbs; errors keep window/page open and alert
limits: Note Pad eight pages of 1024 bytes; Scrapbook 32 TEXT clips of 1024 bytes, each must fit shared TextEdit's line cap
missing_native_captures: Mac OS 8.1 Note Pad idle, dog-ear, page counter and page turn
Mac OS 8.1 Scrapbook idle, n of m label and page scrollbar
composition: documentProc chrome + SimpleText TextEdit and Platinum scrollbar; fold is an explicitly authored functional adaptation, no native pixel fidelity claim
